Campaign: Boss 1 of 41: Ashen Knight. Requires the Ender Dragon unlock before this stage can be summoned.
Defeat the Ender Dragon to unlock the campaign and receive the Boss Summon Tool. An existing Free the End advancement also unlocks it on login. Reclaim a lost tool with /deepnight reclaim.
Where to find: Right-click the Boss Summon Tool on Easy, Normal or Hard. It summons your next undefeated boss near you, in the current dimension. Prepare broad, flat, solid ground and at least 8 blocks of headroom; a roughly 50 x 50 arena gives room to dodge. Bosses have no natural spawns.
One campaign boss can be active across all dimensions. Sneak + use the tool or run /deepnight status for progress and its last location. /deepnight abandon cancels the fight without advancing.
Combat: Total health: 360; base melee damage: 12; armour: 6. These are base values before difficulty, effects and armour mitigation.
A forward cleave reaches 10 blocks. Move out of the outlined cone during its wind-up.

Phases change below 65% and 30% total health, accelerating attacks and calling reinforcements. The boss bar includes reserve health above 1,000 HP. Single hits are capped at 12% of a health segment before armour. Bosses retreat after 30 loaded seconds without a living Survival fighter nearby; retreat does not count as victory.
Victory and rewards: Each eligible campaign survivor receives 4 Ashen Knight Sigils and 4 Night Essence. Only a legitimate combat victory advances the campaign; /kill does not.

For campaign credit, unlock the dragon gate, be on this same campaign stage, deal damage yourself or through your owned pet, and survive within 128 blocks in the same dimension when the boss dies. The guide checkbox records your collection only; it does not advance the campaign. Mark shared victories manually if your normal kill statistic was not credited.

Where to find: No natural spawns. Right-click the reusable Pet Summoning Tool, search for this pet, then choose Summon. It arrives as a full-health, already-tamed adult at level 1. Leave clear space nearby; the tool recharges for 10 seconds.

Craft a Pet Summoning Tool with an Ender Pearl above a Book, a Gold Ingot on each side of the Book, and a Golden Apple below. A level-3 Cleric also sells one for a base price of 24 Emeralds plus 2 Ender Pearls.
Taming: The Pet Summoning Tool gives ownership immediately. If this species was instead spawned untamed with a creative spawn egg or command, feed it 3 Bonding Treats. Only its owner can care for or ride a tamed pet.
Pet care and breeding: Bonding Treats heal 16 health; on babies they also advance growth by 60 seconds. Feed Golden Apples to two tamed adults of the same species to breed; the baby inherits ownership. Craft 4 treats from 1 Night Essence, 1 Golden Carrot and 1 Cooked Beef.
Commands and riding: Sneak + right-click with an empty hand to switch stay/follow. Equip a Saddle on your adult pet, then interact with an empty hand to ride. Riding uses land controls; there are no flight controls.
Growth: Levels 1-50 grant +2% base health and attack per level above 1 (up to +98%). Stay within 32 blocks of your living, online owner for 5 XP every 20 seconds. Nearby pets get 15 XP for a hostile kill by their owner or owned pet, or 100 XP for a Deep Night boss. Each level needs 100 + 25 x (level - 1) XP. Interact with the Pet Summoning Tool to inspect level and XP.
Abilities: Level-1 base health: 90; attack damage: 8; armour: 5. Follows and defends its owner.
Breath attacks reach targets within 14 blocks with line of sight, every 2.5 seconds; base breath damage is 6 and scales with pet level. Ember breath also ignites targets for 3 seconds.

Where to find: Defeat the Ender Dragon to unlock the campaign and receive the Boss Summon Tool. An existing Free the End advancement also unlocks it on login. Reclaim a lost tool with /deepnight reclaim.
Use: Right-click the Boss Summon Tool on Easy, Normal or Hard. It summons your next undefeated boss near you, in the current dimension. Prepare broad, flat, solid ground and at least 8 blocks of headroom; a roughly 50 x 50 arena gives room to dodge. Bosses have no natural spawns.
Sneak + right-click for progress. /deepnight status reports the active fight; /deepnight abandon cancels it without advancing. The tool is reusable.

Where to find: Craft a Pet Summoning Tool with an Ender Pearl above a Book, a Gold Ingot on each side of the Book, and a Golden Apple below. A level-3 Cleric also sells one for a base price of 24 Emeralds plus 2 Ender Pearls.
Use: No natural spawns. Right-click the reusable Pet Summoning Tool, search for this pet, then choose Summon. It arrives as a full-health, already-tamed adult at level 1. Leave clear space nearby; the tool recharges for 10 seconds.
Includes the 31 Deep Night pets plus supported installed TamableAnimal and horse species. Custom ownership systems may not be supported. Use on a tamed pet to inspect its level, XP and health.

Crafting: Craft 4 with 1 Night Essence, 1 Golden Carrot and 1 Cooked Beef (shapeless).
Pet care: The Pet Summoning Tool gives ownership immediately. If this species was instead spawned untamed with a creative spawn egg or command, feed it 3 Bonding Treats. Only its owner can care for or ride a tamed pet.

Bonding Treats heal 16 health; on babies they also advance growth by 60 seconds. Feed Golden Apples to two tamed adults of the same species to breed; the baby inherits ownership. Craft 4 treats from 1 Night Essence, 1 Golden Carrot and 1 Cooked Beef.
